title: Patch: a signature animation for every Classic Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card
thread:
**Issue #3389 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3389: Patch: a signature animation for every Classic Legendary and Mythic, one concept per card
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3332, whose signature tier, takeovers for any card, budgets and ratchet these entries use.

The owner asked (2026-11-06) for every Legendary and Mythic to have an animation of its own, as in Hearthstone, instead of one shared animation.

### Today

- Classic has 11 Legendaries and Mythics: 7 play a shared motif and 4 have recipes of their own (Nature Titan's `titanBloom` entrance, Spell Tyrant's `tyrantSigil`, BOOM! Big Max's `bigBoom`, King Wagtoggle's `crownSwap`), which grow into full signatures.

### What it should be

- **Every card gets a signature.** Every card in the table gets a `signature` entry in its set's `apps/web/src/fx/cards/classic.json5` table, with its recipe in `apps/web/src/fx/cards/classic/`, built from its concept, and leaves `SIGNATURE_PENDING`.
- **The beats by type:**
  - a Unit plays an entrance of its own, then its text's beat;
  - a Spell plays a cast of its own;
  - a permanent plays its arrival, its text's beat, and a standing aura of its own on its tile.
- **A Mythic's takeover is its own,** with its own art filling the screen.
- **A concept is the target, not a script.** The builder keeps each card's idea, and may move a beat to fit the budgets or the events the view carries.
- **The rules every signature keeps:**
  - the signature budgets (#3332), R200, and one set piece per action;
  - reduced motion, speed, intensity and `bigMoments`;
  - never showing a hidden card (R202).
- **Sound.** Each sound is its own, inside the audio budgets.
- **Owned elsewhere** (left out of this table): none.

### The concepts

| id | name | rarity | now | entrance or cast | what its text does, shown | on its tile | sound |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `classic-004` | Palantir | Legendary | cast and trigger negate (hologram); board aura arcane | A black seeing-orb drops onto its zone and its iris opens; one cyan scan-ring sweeps the opponent's side of the board. | Each `drawLimited` drops a cyan shutter over the opponent's deck pile. On the steal, the orb cracks (`destroyed`, base face) and an eye-beam reels the announced Spell across (`stolen`) to cast in cyan. | A slow cyan iris drifts to watch the opponent's side, blinking now and then. | A glassy hum, then a shutter's click. |
| `classic-007` | InfiniScepter | Legendary | cast vanish; zone aura arcane | A crystal sceptre spins down into its zone and plants itself upright, its looped head opening like a locket. | Cry: the Spell picked (owner only until it moves) is drawn into the locket as it is `exiled`, then shown coiled inside. Each `activated`: the sceptre pulses and a spectral copy flies out to cast. | The held Spell turns slowly inside the loop, a violet-teal figure-eight trail circling it. | A crystal chime as it stores, a rising ring on release. |
| `classic-009` | Income Tax | Legendary | cast tether (cash) | On `trapFired` the card snaps upright as an iron strongbox lid flies open; a crimson seal stamps over the opponent's hand. | A copper chain loops the opponent's hand and all but one card back is yanked across into the caster's hand (`stolen`), faces never shown; which card stays is the opponent's choice (owner only). | None: a trap shows nothing face-down (R202) and leaves as it fires. | Strongbox slam, coins clatter, a quill's scratch. |
| `classic-028` | Second Wind | Legendary | cast vanish (wind); side aura storm (wind) | A gale bursts from the zone, flattening the side's banners, and the card lands upright in a whirl of sky-blue wind. | Cry: the deck pile blows away back by back (`exiled`), then the hand scatters into the graveyard (`discarded`). Later a card played from the graveyard rides a gust up; one bound there veers into exile. | A soft breeze ruffles the graveyard pile, leaf-motes lifting off it. | A rushing gust, then a long sigh of wind. |
| `classic-033` | Joro | Legendary | trigger conjure | Nothing shows while he waits in hand. Then a silver thread drops from the board's top edge and Joro swings down upside-down into his zone, grinning. | On `summoned`, a web strand snaps from the enemy Spell's aim to Joro (`redirected`); the Spell's glow bends off its target, strikes him, and he flips upright with a wink. | A faint web shimmers in his zone's corners; a thread sways above him. | A silk zip, a boing, a cheeky chuckle. |
| `classic-044` | Back from the GY | Legendary | cast rise | A violet lantern flare bursts over the caster's graveyard pile and the ground cracks open along the caster's unit row. | Each Unit `summoned` claws up through its zone from below, soil bursting, one after another; then the Spell crumbles to violet ash and drifts into the exile pile (`exiled`). | None. | Thunder rumble, earth cracking, a chorus of groans. |
| `classic-045` | Nature Titan | Legendary | entrance titanBloom; cry flight | The Tribute sinks into soil; roots crack through the zone, a moss boulder heaves up into the Titan, and wildflowers burst open in a ring round its foot. | On its Cry and each attack, a leaf carries a card back to the hand (`drawn`, its face owner only) and a seed of green light flies to the hero, blooming on `healed`. | Moss creeps slowly over its frame; a petal drifts down now and then. | A deep wooden groan, a stone thud, birdsong. |
| `classic-056` | Spell Tyrant | Legendary | bespoke tyrantSigil | A jagged violet crown-sigil slams onto the zone, its points stabbing the stone, and the Tyrant rises through it, robe of scrolls flaring. | Cry: each chosen Spell rises from the graveyard pile as a ghost, bows to the crown, casts on his command, then burns to ash into the exile pile (`exiled`), one after another. | A small violet crown-sigil turns slowly above him. | A commanding horn blast, then a whoosh for each spell. |
| `classic-080` | BOOM! Big Max | Legendary | bespoke bigBoom | The three Tributes sink as a fuse burns along the row; Big Max drops from above and lands fist-first, a white-orange blast throwing dust down the lane. | As he lands his zone cracks into a smoking crater and an iron clamp locks it (`locked`, Crater); later blows slide off him as cinders, and a Trample hit blasts on through to the hero. | Smoke curls from the crater rim; embers tick around his fists. | Fuse hiss, a huge boom, rubble rain. |
| `classic-085` | King Wagtoggle | Legendary | bespoke crownSwap | A velvet cloak sweeps in; the king tips his lopsided silver crown to the far side and holds out a hand to shake. | On `swapped`, the two deck piles bow, cross under his crown and settle on each other's side, card backs only; on the Radiant face a card leaps from his new deck into play (`summoned`). | A slow crimson shimmer runs along his cloak hem, and now and then he winks. | A hearty laugh, a handshake slap, a riffle. |
| `classic-090` | In Too Deep | Mythic | cast and trigger tally; side aura void (shadow) | Takeover: the screen tips into a spiral shaft plunging into violet dark, a climber's rope uncoiling past glowing shrines; black-blue water rushes in and the card surfaces on its zone. | Each `questProgressed` ticks a shrine-light one step down a spiral on the card. On `questCompleted` the shrine bursts open, its rewards glowing (owner only), and the chosen path lights the next shrine below. | A slow whirlpool of black-blue water turns on its zone, a faint light at its bottom. | A deep water rumble, a far bell for each quest. |

## Acceptance

- Every card in the table has a `signature` entry and recipe and is off `SIGNATURE_PENDING`. `tables.test.ts`, `tiers.test.ts` and `coverage.test.ts` pass.
- `/dev/fx` shows each signature. A component spec plays every card in the table at desktop size and at 390x844, and `fx-phone-frame.cy.tsx` covers this group's two heaviest within `FX_PHONE_FRAME_BUDGET_MS`.
- Each Mythic's takeover draws its own art, and reduced motion shows its still form.
- No beat shows a hidden card. A test plays each card with a Discover, a hand or a face-down trap from the opponent's seat.
- The pull request holds the per-card table with each card's verdict. Any ruling is in this issue's block, with the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.
- The web tests, `typecheck`, `eslint` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
```
